descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S08 「今天名单上、但不在照片上的住户，不会被一声不响地从今天拿掉」 A resident on today's list who is not on the photo is not dropped from today without a word

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U2 Photographing the nursing supervisor's list adds the residents on it to Today's Visits. Residents already in All Residents go onto today's list, and new ones are created.（UAT TC-09；TFA-92587 AC 3；TFA-92587 How it works 3）
  • U5 Marking 'In Today' puts the resident on the Today's Visits tab. Un-marking removes them from today without deleting them: they stay in All Residents.（UAT TC-09；TFA-92587 AC 2；TFA-92587 How it works 2；TFA-92587 How it works 6）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Fixture resident In Today (MRN 'QA-<tag>-10'); QA Alder (Oak 1, MRN 'QA-<tag>-01') in All Residents, not In Today; no date of birth anywhere (D5)

When Scan a one-row photo listing only QA Alder, confirm, then check Today's Visits and All Residents

Then Per the UAT ('the photo adds residents') and AC 3 ('never silently dropping'): QA Alder joins Today's Visits, and the fixture resident is still on Today's Visits. Both stay in All Residents

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs: s08-today contains QA Alder and {snfResident} and mustNotContain 'In Today ✓', so a checkpoint saved on All Residents cannot pass (U2 'the photo adds residents to Today's Visits'); s08-all contains both and 'In Today ✓' (U5 never deleted). Judged against the UAT wording. …

在哪跑：dev 单元 U77；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S08 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-09.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：被产品问题挡住 · 环境 dev · 票 TFA-92587 ready for qa；TFA-94425 ready for qa

dev 上一张清楚的单行名单照片也提示「No residents found. Try a clearer photo.」，所以没法判断照片上没有的住户会不会被悄悄移出今天名单。

On dev, a clear one-row census photo comes back as 'No residents found. Try a clearer photo.', so the test could not check whether a resident who is not on the photo gets silently dropped from Today's Visits.

依据：allure 32fce1c4: the agent stopped at the scan error with 4 of 5 checkpoints not reached. Ledger U77: Gemini wraps the JSON in a ```json fence, and vision.scanCensusSheet parses it with a bare JSON.parse (convex/ai/vision.ts:49 -> convex/lib/modelJson.ts:98), so 0 rows come back. Reproduced locally. The same bug pauses U78-U81 (TC-09 S04/S06/S07/S17). Once unblocked, S08 is judged against 'adds' (TC-09 Q1, add vs replace, Daniela).

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
